title: Token SLI continuous sampler and regional failover policy simulator
creator: Aisha Gupta
description: Build a continuous token-level SLI sampler and a policy simulator that lets SRE/Platform teams define regional circuit-breaker/failover rules and run realistic traffic scenarios. The goal is to (1) produce stable sliding-window token-latency SLIs that correlate with tail LLM latency, (2) emit sampled traces and histogram shards to the observability pipeline without high cardinality cost, and (3) provide an interactive simulator + dashboard to validate failover policies before rollouts. This ticket includes the sampler design, a lightweight sampling agent, instrumentation hooks, simulator backend, and a Grafana dashboard + playbook snippets.
acceptance_criteria: Continuous sampler ingests 100% of admitted requests and produces a 1% sampled token-latency stream (configurable) to the metrics pipeline
Sliding-window token SLI calc implemented in pipeline: per-region, per-model, per-priority with p50/p95/p99 buckets and token-rate normalized metrics
Simulator can replay synthetic and recent-production traffic to exercise failover rules and output summary: tokens-shed, p99 delta, and successful fallback counts
Dashboard with at least three panels: sampled token-latency histograms, simulator results heatmap, and policy-visualizer timeline
End-to-end test that toggles a regional circuit in the simulator and verifies SPANs emitted and correct SLI derivation
Documentation and runbook added with example policies and recommended thresholds for P0/P1 workloads
comments: 2026-02-26 - Kickoff: reviewed scope with SRE and product; agreed to keep sample rate default at 1% but make it runtime-configurable per-project.

2026-03-01 - Design review: Decided to implement sampler as sidecar on serving nodes to avoid central bottleneck; will emit compact histograms (HdrHistogram compressed) and derive token-percentiles downstream.
2026-03-03 - Engineering note: Initial PR for sampler agent created (PR #1284). Sampler serializes per-request token timings as delta-encoded int arrays to keep payload small.

2026-03-05 - Observability: agreed on metric schema: token_latency.histogram{region,model,priority,commit} and token_latency.sampled_count{...}. Indexing limited to region+model+priority to control cardinality.

2026-03-07 - Simulation: prototype simulator accepts trace bundles or synthetic workload generator (token length distributions by customer). Early runs show p99 spikes when regional admission drops below 60%.
2026-03-09 - Security review request filed for sidecar telemetry endpoint; marked security_review_required=false for now but will revisit if telemetry expands to user payloads.
2026-03-11 - UX: Dashboard wireframe uploaded; request counters, histogram heatmap, and an interactive policy timeline were requested by SRE lead (Marta Ruiz).
2026-03-12 - Next steps: finalize sampler backpressure handling, add automated test harness for simulator scenarios, and start dashboard implementation. Assigned PR reviewers: @leo-w, @marta-r.
